verifier.notes:
Verifier attempt 2 of 2, fresh context, from papers/excerpts/vangeel2010.txt alone. Rows numbered 1-5 in file order (quotes use row index 0-4). All 62 quotes are verbatim in the source; validator ok.
FAILED CELLS (1):
row 4, endpoint_definition: written 'share of patients reporting some colour mismatch' unbracketed. The source says only 'In 80% some colour mismatch (hyperpigmentation and hypopigmentation) was reported between the treated area and the surrounding skin'; it names no unit (patients or answers) and no reporter (patients or examiners; Methods say 'examination and questionnaire'). The row's own analysis_unit and assessment_method now say both are not in abstract, so this cell contradicts them. Needs e.g. 'share [of patients or answers, not stated] with some colour mismatch reported'.
NOT FAILED: rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 pass every cell. Row 4 fixed cells (patients_evaluable, analysis_unit, assessment_method, time_from_start, time_from_last_treatment) and the shared uncertainty sentence on all 5 rows are correct as fixed. months_after_final_tx NOT_DERIVABLE correct on all rows; outcome tiers are the weakest supported reading (row 1 >75% is partial; row 4 unquantified, not lasting_color_match). Hyperpigmentation is recorded on row 4 dark_overshoot; rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 'not in abstract' for dark_overshoot is acceptable because the abstract ties hyperpigmentation only to the reported mismatch, not to those endpoints. Minor, not failed: design 'single centre' rests on the bracketed affiliation; row 5 '[about 93% reported no loss, inferred]' would be closer to the source as 'did not report loss'.

fix_round_1.verifier_1_notes:
Rows are numbered 1-5 in file order (quotes use row index 0-4). All 62 quotes are verbatim in the source; validator ok. Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 pass on every cell. Failures all come from one unstated link: the abstract never says the colour-mismatch figure came from the questionnaire, or which patients it counts. Its sentence is 'In 80% some colour mismatch (hyperpigmentation and hypopigmentation) was reported between the treated area and the surrounding skin'. It gives no denominator, no unit and no reporter, and Methods say patients were evaluated 'by examination and questionnaire'. (Compare 'According to the patients, final repigmentation...', which does name its reporter.)
